'''''Arctotis stoechadifolia''''', the '''African daisy'''<ref>{{PLANTS|id=ARST2|taxon=Arctotis stoechadifolia|accessdate=8 January 2016}}</ref> or '''white arctotis''',<ref name=BSBI07>{{BSBI 2007 |accessdate=2014-10-17 }}</ref> is a species of [[South Africa]]n flowering plants in the family [[Asteraceae]]. It is a rare plant found only in its native range in [[sand dunes]] along the West coast of [[Cape Province]].<ref>Norlindh, Nils Tycho 1965.  Botaniska Notiser 118(4): 406–411</ref> However, it has also been introduced in New Zealand.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Arctotis stoechadifolia |url=https://www.nzpcn.org.nz/flora/species/arctotis-stoechadifolia/ |access-date=2026-01-11 |website=New Zealand Plant Conservation Network |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Flora of New Zealand {{!}} Taxon Profile {{!}} Arctotis stoechadifolia |url=https://www.nzflora.info/factsheet/Taxon/Arctotis-stoechadifolia.html |access-date=2026-01-11 |website=www.nzflora.info}}</ref>

The species is sometimes regarded as the same species as the much more common and widely cultivated ''[[Arctotis venusta|A. venusta]]'', but authors separate the two as distinct species.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Arctotis stoechadifolia in Flora of North America @ efloras.org |url=http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=1&taxon_id=242412220 |access-date=2022-05-03 |website=www.efloras.org}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Arctotis venusta Calflora |url=https://www.calflora.org/app/taxon?crn=11348 |access-date=2022-05-03 |website=www.calflora.org}}</ref>
